newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain may launch strippable bonds in July.
newsitem.headline: Spain may launch strippable bonds in July.

text.p: Spain may launch strippable bonds in July, Spanish Treasury director general Jaime Caruana said on Tuesday.
"The issuance of bonds which can be stripped could be in July. From then trading will be halted for a few months until market liquidity is enough," he told reporters after a seminar.
Caruana said the new trade may start in September or October.

The director general said the new strippable bonds will be issued with maturities of five-, 10-, and 15-years. He added that investment funds are expected to be particularly interested in the instrument.
Spain has been considering launching a strips market since late 1996.
